nist_800_53_rev5.name: Account Management
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Manages information system accounts including establishment, activation, modification, review, disabling, and removal. Monitors the use of accounts and notifies account managers of significant events.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Access Enforcement
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Enforces approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources in accordance with applicable access control policies.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Separation of Duties
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Identifies and documents duties of individuals requiring separation and defines system access authorizations to support separation of duties.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Least Privilege
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Employs the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses for users which are necessary to accomplish assigned organizational tasks.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Remote Access
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Establishes usage restrictions, configuration requirements, and implementation guidance for each type of remote access allowed and authorizes remote access prior to allowing such connections.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Event Logging
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Identifies the types of events that the system is capable of logging and coordinates the event logging function with other organizational entities requiring audit-related information.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Content of Audit Records
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Ensures audit records contain information that establishes what type of event occurred, when it occurred, where, source, outcome, and identity of any individuals or subjects associated with the event.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Reviews and analyzes system audit records for indications of inappropriate or unusual activity and reports findings to designated personnel.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Protection of Audit Information
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Protects audit information and audit logging tools from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Audit Record Generation
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Provides audit record generation capability for the auditable events defined in AU-2 at all system components where audit capability is deployed.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Uniquely identifies and authenticates organizational users and associates that unique identification with processes acting on behalf of those users.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Identifier Management
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Manages system identifiers by receiving authorization, selecting identifiers, assigning to intended individuals, and preventing reuse for a defined period.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Authenticator Management
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Manages system authenticators by verifying initial authenticator content, establishing authenticator strength, and changing default authenticators upon system installation.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Identification and Authentication (Non-Organizational Users)
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Uniquely identifies and authenticates non-organizational users or processes acting on behalf of non-organizational users.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Risk Assessment
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Conducts assessments of risk including the likelihood and magnitude of harm from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification, or destruction of the system.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Monitors and scans for vulnerabilities in the system and hosted applications and analyzes vulnerability scan reports and results from security control assessments.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Risk Response
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Responds to findings from security and privacy assessments, monitoring, and audits in accordance with organizational risk tolerance.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Criticality Analysis
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Identifies critical system components and functions by performing a criticality analysis at key decision points in the system development life cycle.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Boundary Protection
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Monitors and controls communications at the external managed interfaces to the system and at key internal managed interfaces within the system.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Protects the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information using cryptographic mechanisms or alternative physical safeguards.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Establishes and manages cryptographic keys when cryptography is employed within the system in accordance with key management requirements.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Cryptographic Protection
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Determines the cryptographic uses and types of cryptography required for each use and implements the required cryptographic protections using validated cryptography.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Protection of Information at Rest
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Protects the confidentiality and integrity of information at rest using cryptographic mechanisms or other organization-defined controls.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Flaw Remediation
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Identifies, reports, and corrects system flaws and tests software and firmware updates for effectiveness and potential side effects before installation.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Malicious Code Protection
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Implements signature-based and non-signature-based malicious code protection mechanisms at system entry and exit points to detect and eradicate malicious code.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: System Monitoring
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Monitors the system to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks and unauthorized local, network, and remote connections.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Security Alerts, Advisories, and Directives
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Receives system security alerts, advisories, and directives from external organizations on an ongoing basis and generates internal alerts to designated personnel.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Employs integrity verification tools to detect unauthorized changes to software, firmware, and information.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Information Input Validation
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Checks the validity of information inputs to the system to verify that they conform to specified format and content requirements.

nist_800_53_rev5.name: Information Management and Retention
nist_800_53_rev5.description: Manages and retains information within the system and information output from the system in accordance with applicable laws, executive orders, directives, regulations, and operational requirements.

coso_2013.principle: Demonstrates Commitment to Integrity and Ethical Values
coso_2013.description: The organization demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values, setting the tone at the top through codes of conduct, policies, and leadership behavior.
The board of directors demonstrates independence from management and exercises oversight of the development and performance of internal control.
The organization specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable the identification and assessment of risks relating to those objectives, including financial reporting and compliance.
The organization identifies risks to the achievement of its objectives across the entity and analyzes risks as a basis for determining how the risks should be managed.
The organization selects and develops control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks to the achievement of objectives to acceptable levels.
The organization deploys control activities through policies that establish what is expected and procedures that put the policies into action.
The organization obtains or generates and uses relevant, quality information to support the functioning of internal control.
The organization communicates with external parties regarding matters affecting the functioning of internal control, including disclosures to regulators and stakeholders.
The organization selects, develops, and performs ongoing and separate evaluations to ascertain whether the components of internal control are present and functioning.
The organization evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies in a timely manner to those parties responsible for taking corrective action, including senior management and the board.
